criterion: The signed-in workspace sits on a near-black cool neutral ground, and the public help pages sit on a warm near-white neutral ground.
evaluation_rule: Answer yes when the workspace screens read as a dark cool field and the help pages read as a warm pale field. Answer no when both surfaces share one ground tone.

criterion: Across the inbox and the settings screens one mid, vivid blue marks every control a person can press, and the keyboard focus ring uses that same blue.
evaluation_rule: Answer yes when the pressable controls and the focus ring share one blue. Answer no when a second hue also marks a pressable control.

criterion: In the conversation thread and the inbox list, failure is marked in a mid, vivid red, success in a mid, vivid green, and work still in progress in a light, vivid amber.
evaluation_rule: Answer yes when those three states each carry their own hue and other states carry none of the three. Answer no when a neutral state borrows one of them.

criterion: Colour, type size and spacing reach the inbox screens through named tokens, so every panel repeats one ground tone and one gap unit.
evaluation_rule: Answer yes when the same ground tone and gap recur across panels. Answer no when two panels of the same kind carry different ground tones.

criterion: The inbox shows three separate empty states: a workspace holding zero conversations, a filter that matched zero rows, and a queue worked to the end.
evaluation_rule: Answer yes when the three read as three different messages. Answer no when two of them share one message.

criterion: A conversation open in two places shows the teammates currently reading that conversation by generated avatar, and an unsent reply survives navigating away and returning.
evaluation_rule: Answer yes when the avatars appear for the readers and the draft returns intact. Answer no when the draft is lost on navigation.

criterion: The onboarding list above the inbox marks each item done once the workspace state satisfies that item, and the report screen read by a manager covers the led teams alone.
evaluation_rule: Answer yes when the list reflects real workspace state. Answer no when an item stays marked done after the underlying state is undone.

criterion: The conversation list draws placeholder rows at the height of a real row during a first load, so each row holds position once data arrives.
evaluation_rule: Answer yes when nothing shifts as the list fills. Answer no when the rows jump once data arrives.

criterion: The signed-in screens keep a narrow icon rail on the left at a fixed width in a fixed order, with the customer-facing help pages using a top bar instead.
evaluation_rule: Answer yes when the rail keeps one width and one order across screens. Answer no when the rail reorders itself by use.

criterion: Panels in the inbox are separated by a hairline border and a change of ground tone, with corners barely softened and avatars the one round shape.
evaluation_rule: Answer yes when panels read as separate through border and ground alone. Answer no when a drop shadow lifts a panel off the page.

criterion: Interface copy across the workspace is set in a geometric grotesque, help page reading copy is set in a light serif, and figures line up in a column wherever counts stack.
evaluation_rule: Answer yes when the two faces are distinct and the figures align. Answer no when one face carries both surfaces.

criterion: Pointing at a link in the workspace or on a help page grows a hairline underneath from left to right at one speed.
evaluation_rule: Answer yes when the underline animates across at one speed everywhere. Answer no when a link changes colour alone.

criterion: With a reduced-motion preference set, decorative movement on the inbox screens and the help pages stops, and the link underline, the focus ring and state changes remain.
evaluation_rule: Answer yes when decoration halts and those three remain. Answer no when the focus ring also stops animating.

criterion: Body copy in the inbox and on the help pages holds a contrast ratio of at least 4.5 to 1 against its own ground.
evaluation_rule: Answer yes when measured body copy clears 4.5 to 1 on both surfaces. Answer no when either surface falls under it.

criterion: Every control in the inbox is reachable from the keyboard with a visible focus ring, and each state carries a word beside its colour.
evaluation_rule: Answer yes when tabbing reaches every control with a visible ring and each state is labelled. Answer no when a control is reachable by pointer alone.

criterion: At a phone width the inbox holds inside the screen, with every rail destination still reachable.
evaluation_rule: Answer yes when the page holds its width and every destination is reachable. Answer no when the page scrolls sideways.

criterion: Touch targets in the inbox and the composer measure at least 44 by 44 pixels on a coarse pointer.
evaluation_rule: Answer yes when the measured targets clear 44 by 44 pixels. Answer no when a target falls under that size.
